Package org.thewhitemage13.processor

Class OrderProcessor

java.lang.Object
org.thewhitemage13.processor.OrderProcessor
All Implemented Interfaces:
OrderProcessorInterface
@Component public class OrderProcessor extends Object implements OrderProcessorInterface
The OrderProcessor class is responsible for processing orders and converting order entities into Data Transfer Objects (DTOs) and events.

This class implements the OrderProcessorInterface and provides methods to create a ShowOrderDTO object from an Order entity, as well as to initialize an OrderCreatedEvent from the same entity.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Converting an Order entity to a ShowOrderDTO for presentation.
  • Initializing an OrderCreatedEvent for order-related events.

Usage:

This component is used to transform order data for various use cases such as displaying order information or publishing order-related events (e.g., order creation).

    • orderEventInitialize

      public org.thewhitemage13.OrderCreatedEvent orderEventInitialize(Order order)
      Initializes an OrderCreatedEvent from an Order entity.

      This method creates an OrderCreatedEvent object that is used to publish events related to order creation. The event carries relevant order data like user ID, order items, and status.
